videos.title: Breakfast
videos.description: Hannah French presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

videos.title: Saturday Morning
videos.description: Tom Service chats to composer Caroline Shaw about her extraordinary creative world. Also, Tom talks to Errollyn Wallen about her latest opera, A Christmas Miracle.

videos.title: Earlier... with Jools Holland
videos.description: Jools is joined by the writer Robin Llewellyn to discuss Portmeirion and its musical connections.

videos.title: Key Changes: Radio 3's Essential History of Classical Music
videos.description: 1897, Vienna. Beneath Vienna's cultural brilliance, anxiety about the future is beginning to influence a new generation of composers.

videos.title: Record Review
videos.description: Andrew McGregor with the best new classical releases.

videos.title: Sound of Cinema
videos.description: The stories behind the movies, told through music, with Edith Bowman- featuring interviews with Behemoth! director Tony Gilroy and star Pedro Pascal alongside composer Emily Bear.

videos.title: This Classical Life
videos.description: Jess Gillam swaps musical choices with the violinist and presenter of Radio 4's Add to Playlist, Anna Phoebe.

videos.title: Opera on 3
videos.description: Ginger Costa-Jackson sings Carmen at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden, with Russell Thomas as her obsessed Don José and Sesto Quatrini conducting.

videos.title: Music Planet
videos.description: Lopa Kothari presents the best in folk and roots-based music from around the world, including a live session from Ghanaian kologo player King Ayisoba.

videos.title: New Music Show
videos.description: Highlights from the opening weekend of this year's Huddersfield Contemporary Music Festival, including the UK premiere of James Dillon's Lamentations :.

videos.title: Through the Night
videos.description: Jakub Hrusa conducts the Zurich Tonhalle Orchestra in Suk's Symphony No 2 in C minor 'Asrael'. Organist Christian Schmitt joins them for Hosokawa's Embrace - Light and Shadow.

videos.title: Breakfast
videos.description: Radio 3's breakfast show, waking the UK up with the finest classical music.

videos.title: Sunday Morning
videos.description: Join Sarah Walker for the perfect Sunday playlist with music for advent and concertos by Ethel Smyth and Joseph Haydn.

videos.title: Private Passions
videos.description: Michael Berkeley's guest is the actor and star of Bridgerton, Luke Thompson.

videos.title: Music Map
videos.description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch roams the musical landscape around JS Bach's Advent cantata 'Wachet Auf!', with Handel's Fireworks, Wagner's night watch and The Everly Brothers' wake up call.

videos.title: A Service for Advent with Carols
videos.description: A Service for Advent with Carols, live from the Chapel of St John's College, Cambridge, with music by Lucy Walker, Gibbons, Laura Sheils, Wayne Marshall and Bach.

videos.title: Jazz Record Requests
videos.description: Alyn Shipton has the pick of your requests featuring a galaxy of jazz stars, including Dizzy Gillespie, Billie Holiday and Miles Davis.

videos.title: The Early Music Show
videos.description: Hannah French talks to Robert Hollingworth, founder of the solo vocal ensemble I Fagiolini, which celebrates its 40th anniversary this year.

videos.title: Classical Mixtape
videos.description: Take time out with a 30-minute soundscape of classical music, including a motet by Bruckner and Venus from Holst's The Planets.

videos.title: Sunday Feature: Berkeley's Britten
videos.description: For the first time, Michael Berkeley tells the story of the relationship between his godfather, Benjamin Britten, and his father, the composer Lennox Berkeley.

videos.title: Words and Music
videos.description: Impressions of impressionism with readings from Monet's letters and poems about water lilies and hay fields alongside music by Debussy, Cécile Chaminade, Erik Satie and Ravel.

videos.title: Brass Banding with Hannah Peel
videos.description: Hannah is joined by members of Easington Colliery Band, who accompanied Sam Fender on his Mercury Prize-winning album.

videos.title: Compline
videos.description: A reflective service of night prayer from the Chapel of Lambeth Palace, London, led by the Archbishop of Canterbury and sung by St Martin's Voices.

videos.title: Night Tracks
videos.description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

videos.title: Unclassified
videos.description: Elizabeth Alker with a late-night journey through new music from today's most exciting genre-defying artists.

videos.title: Through the Night
videos.description: Pianist Vadym Kholodenko joins the Norwegian Radio Orchestra and conductor Leslie Suganandarajah in Brahms's Second Piano Concerto, and the orchestra plays Schubert's 4th Symphony.

videos.title: Breakfast
videos.description: Tom McKinney presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

videos.title: Essential Classics
videos.description: Georgia Mann plays the best in classical music for your morning, with discoveries and surprises rubbing shoulders with familiar favourites.

videos.title: Classical Live
videos.description: Violinist Bomsori Kim and pianist Kevin Chen perform live from Wigmore Hall, alongside a celebration of string instruments and highlights from this year's Lammermuir Festival.

videos.title: Composer of the Week: Britten
videos.description: 1/5. Between the sounds of the sea and the singing afternoons with mother in 'heaven', Donald Macleod listens to the first musical experiments of a little prodigy from Suffolk.

videos.title: In Tune
videos.description: Live music and interviews from the world's finest classical musicians.

videos.title: Classical Mixtape
videos.description: Take time out with a 30-minute soundscape of classical favourites.

videos.title: Radio 3 in Concert
videos.description: Chloé Van Soeterstède conducts the Ulster Orchestra in works by Lili Boulanger, Berlioz and Saint-Saëns at the Ulster Hall. Also featuring mezzo-soprano Niamh O'Sullivan.

videos.title: The Essay: How Music Heals
videos.description: As part of her investigation of how music therapy works, Philippa Perry travels Edinburgh to meet newly qualified therapists and improvise with them in a group therapy session.

videos.title: Night Tracks
videos.description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

videos.title: 'Round Midnight
videos.description: Soweto is back with another week of the best in jazz, and his guest is American drummer and producer Nate Smith. He is picking four of his favourite influential records for 4/4.
